eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: Ku lɔ ëë dhööl ciɛɛlic ajɔk rɔt ëë tha thiɛ̈ɛ̈r ku tök (11.00) ëë yuul thin wën (UTC+1) ke kuac ɣɛɛr ce yenhom tiŋ keek ke ɣön apuruk të thiäk ke të rëër Bɛ̈nydït Baai thin.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Kan ci tha thiɛ̈ɛ̈r ku tök lɔ ka akuutdït ëë kɔc ye acï dhöl thiɔ̈kic aloŋ tueŋ ëë thurumbil ye kɔc cath thin.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Ëë  thaa thiɛ̈ɛ̈r ku tök ka apuruk ye kɔc dɔm aci kɔc cï dhöl thiɔ̈k nhom thiɛ̈ɛ̈c ku bïk dhuuk ciɛ̈ɛ̈n ku keek awic bë keek yiɛ̈ɛ̈k të bik keek ya cath ëë ke cök të cï dhöl nhom thiäŋ ëë thurumbil.

text: Eë tha thiɛ̈ɛ̈r ku tökic ke kɔc cï dhöl thiɔ̈ɔ̈k nhom keek aci lɔ Trafalgar alɔŋ dhölë tëëk Aldwych ku jɔl ya dhöl ëë Kingway bë lɔ̈ Holborn të wënnë yen loi ëë diäär ëë yandit thin makɔ̈u ëë ke cï ke cin dɔm ku leek kë ɣön abakeny.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: Aye athöör  nyuɔth lɔnadë kë ɣɔ̈t thiaar ku ŋuan ëë wëu tɔ̈ɔ̈u thiin aci  kɔc loŋ jiɛɛk kuony  biik  tiim ce kuen wëu pan Amerika ye cɔɔl Dollar a thian  bë  tene ye kek juɛ̈r  atap ku jɔl ya lɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈k ajuɛ̈ɛ̈r.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: Ɣöndït ëë gätë wëël pannë  British ye cɔɔl Guardian aci thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ ke vön ëë tɔ̈ɔ̈u wëu ye cɔɔl Deutsche aci tiim tök ku buɔt ka rou aci gël tën akuut kɔ̈k.
eng_text: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

eng_text: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

eng_text: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

eng_text: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

eng_text: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: Raan cɔl John Grant tɔ nï WNED Buffaloɣic (home station Reading Rainbow) "ku jɛɛm kɔcke Reading Rainbow,... aye miith piooc bikki kuɛn ku bikki kuɛɛn nhiaarɣic - [ku niye] piooc kanɣic ɛɛ miith lɛɛk bikki buk kuany ku kuɛnkë."
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: Aye yuu naan maan ye kan acennë wɛu taau thin agut raan cɔl John Grant, atɔthin kennë kɛk loŋë kakkë piooc ɣic ni thaa loi kang rɔth.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Apuɔ̈k aci rɔt looi abaŋ ciɛɛm të thɔ̈ɔ̈ny ye cɔɔl Cape Verde, yen abë thiäi ëë ɣän kɔ̈k, aci kɔc ye daai ëë käk aliiric luel.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Eë mën thinnë  yoomdït atɔ̈ thin ku ka wel ye nhom të lɔ tueŋ.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Yoomdït cɔɔl Fred ëë thoŋ ëë kɔc ɣeer, yen acï yök aloŋ ciɛ̈n ku jɔl ya alɔŋ cuɛ̈ɛ̈c të bï ëë Atlantic mënnë ëtɛ̈ɛ̈k ë kë dït ye käŋ tïŋ, kä  tɔ̈ nhial ye cɔɔl kënë käŋ cooc. Yen aci yök ke ye kɔɔrdït rɛ̈ɛ̈r kɔɔr kadiak cök aloŋ cuëëc ëë kë cït thiɛ̈ɛ̈rdiak ku dhiëëc.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Eë pɛi dhoŋuan ke ye nïïn thiɛ̈ɛ̈rou ku ŋuan ëë run tiɛm tök ku buɔt ka dhorou ku thiɛ̈ɛ̈rdhiɛ̈ɛ̈c ku dhoŋuan ke pan ye cɔɔl  Arthur Guinness  acë ka rɛ̈ɛ̈r piny ëë St James' Gate Brewery tɔ pan ye cɔɔl  Dublin, Ireland acë mɛ̈ɛ̈l ku bë rɛ̈ɛ̈r keek  tiim ka dhoŋuan
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: Ee ruɔ̈n bot karou ku thiɛ̈ɛ̈rdhiɛ̈ɛ̈c ka akut ëë ɣɔɔc wɛɛi ëë käŋ acï rɔt juak agut bë naŋ kë cïït bianabur thiäär ëë wëu pannë Europe ëë ruɔ̈n thok ebɛ̈n.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid ee raan tɔ̈ŋ ëë ye kuëth akut ë Zealand yic ku ye akölë, ka cë raan nɔŋ ruun ka thiɛ̈ɛ̈rŋuan ku bɛ̈ɛ̈t ye cɔɔl Auckland Harbour Bridge wuɔ̈ɔ̈r ëë kat .
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Mony ye cɔɔl Reid acë lëu ku bë kat ayic dhorou ëë kamdït meecic apɛɛi ëë Kubur nhom.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: Apuruk ke piny ëë Zealand keek acë kat ëë thurumbil cɔɔl Radar, acik yök ke rielic të wën wic keek bïk të cït të kɛ̈t Reid thïn ŋic ku të cï keek bɛ̈n ŋic ee tën awën cï keek gɛ̈ɛ̈r den miɛt nyin piny keek apuruk mac kɔc.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Ëë pɛ̈ɛ̈ï cï lɔ wäär kadiäk, ke kɔc ëë ke cï keek maac ka thiɛ̈ɛ̈r bɛ̈ɛ̈t, keek acï luɔ̈ny bei ɣɔɔn në dööm ke cën luŋ cë looi.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: EE pɛɛi ŋuan ee ruɔ̈n ke löŋ acë bɛ̈n bei tënnë raandït muk löŋ ye cɔɔl Glynn lan bï kɔc cï maac lac a lony të cin en luŋ cï dac cɔɔl ëë Bɛ̈nydït muk löŋ.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Bɛ̈ny acï wɛ̈ɛ̈r yen kɔc waar cɔl atɔ̈ rin ku bë kä cë ke raan cë waar kum ya gät piny athööric ku jɔl ya bë ke täu ëë luŋ ye käŋ täu thin.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Pïŋ ëë thiɛ̈ɛ̈c ë thok ëë köl ëë raan cï awuɔ̈c looi, yen aye nyuɔth.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello  raan ee muuk Australian yen aniɛɛr bë bɛ̈ny baai cɔɔl John Howard tiam bë ya raan akuut ëë bäny ku bë kuny de gam aloŋ ëë cirkadït ëë dhɛ̈ɛ̈ŋ.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Raan ye ccɔɔl Costello aci luel lonadë ke riɛl ëë këdït ëë thääthë mɛ̈ɛ̈c yen acï tɔ̈ ke cë ŋiɛ̈ɛ̈c looi apuɔth ku Australia abï luoi de kuany cök.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: Të bii ɣen ke ye kënnë ɣooc kä bë rɛ̈ɛ̈r ke ɣook . Yen të de, acën të bï keek kuec ëë en thin yen këdït tuuc. Aci Costello luel.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Eë wɛ̈t ë raan cɔɔl Ansa,  bolis e diɛ̈r wet nɛ̈k baany Mafia rot kaamken arin atëër bany ku wet bi yen tɔŋ dit tet cɔl ala riip .
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: Acï apuruk luel lan ye Lo Piccolo nɔŋ ɣen cindït tënnë Provenzano ku jɔl ya nyiɛ̈ny dit de ace yiɛ̈ athɛɛk ëkɔc thɛɛr ago wël ëë raan cɔɔl Provenzano muk nhiima go baai lɔ tueeŋ keek riɛɛl.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: Bɛ̈ny muk Apple ye cɔɔl Steve Jobs acë luŋ jam bɛ̈I bei ku nyuuth kɔc wën cë kë kenhïïm kuut.
eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Të wën jiɛm ɣen ëë thaa karou go luel akölë ke Apple abë dhuɔ̈k piny bï ya këpuɔth ëë yaam bë ya ɣook kë laŋ anyiköl ë yaköle.

text: Brazil enë paan wɛ̈n dït de Roman Catholic pinynhom ëbɛ̈n, ku kɔc ke luaŋ e Catholic ke Roman aye jaai na thiëŋ e moc ku moc ku thiëŋ e tik kek tiŋdɛ̈t.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Kɔc lon akuma ke Brazil acïï ye löŋ në thiëŋ e moc ku moc ku thiëŋ e tik ku tik jaamyic në run kee 10 ku thiëŋ kekë ye rot loi në pään e Rio Gande do sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: Löŋ tueŋ ee guiir në Mayor de paan de SãoPaulo thɛɛr, Marta Suplicy. Löŋ cï luel, arɛ̈k cë cɔ̈k piny, arɛ̈ɛ̈r në Roberto Jefferson ciin.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: Kɔc kek cï jai në ye löŋ kekë acigät aye tɔ̈u ka kek bï gät në petition cï thany në kɔc ke mallion ke 1.2 në pɛi 11.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Të wɛ̈n cën rot nyuɔth lɔn wïc bɛ̈i/anïn juëc në kuɔny de ganuun kubïk thɔ̈r ke copë wei në ɣɔ̈nkɛniic, kë amat e cii looi kë Pɛi Diäk ë nïn 20 abaŋ de East Bay Community Law Center tënë  kɔc wɛ̈n kek cïn ɣöötkɛn kual.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Ɣɔn cïï kɔc cë ɣööt ken jäi ke cï rot luɛ kek luɛl, bääi wɛ̈n kek e tɔ̈u thïn acikï tïŋ
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Kɔc kek rɛɛr në pään e Lockwood_Garden aye jääm ku luɛl ke anɔŋ bääi kɔ̈k ke thiɛr ŋuan ku lɛɛr tueŋ kek cop e mɛɛn cïï kɛɛk yen tïŋ akum e OHA a cɛɛr ye bäi kɔ̈k wɛ̈n kɛɛk tɔ̈u Oakland wɛ̈n kɛɛk cïï kɛɛk cuɛr aya.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: kɔc ke cïït e diat aci ketden teemkɔ̈u në baŋ e Maui's War Memorial Stadium, wɛ̈n yen e bi kɔc ke 9,000 lɔ thïn.
eng_text: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: Kɔmpänï e kɔc ke cïït e diat yen ye col HK  Management Inc, akin wat e tem ket kɔ̈u luɛl ne kol e nïïn 20 nï pɛi thiäär ku tök, acïï kɔc ke aguɛɛr gɔk.
eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: Abukuum e paanë Greek wɛ̈n ŋic, Sakis Kechagioglou ku George Nikolakopoulos acë kek mac në thïjïn e Athens e Korydallus, wat cï kek yök kek awäny ariöpë thok.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: Në ciäär de yic, te la gɔk acïï yök në akuma ë Greek yic yen naŋ abukuum acïï yök ka kek loi kak wɛ̈n cë kak la cɔɔk në run yen cë la.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Në ithbuɔɔ cë tëëk, raan ee lon cɔɔl wɛ̈n ye cɔl Makis Triantafylopoulos në baŋ den e television cɔl "Zoungla" ye nyuɔth në Alpha TV, raan yen lui kekë akuma kuye abukum, Petros Mantalouvalos ë cïï kuum wat cïï kɔc kek lui keke yen aci kek yök kekë awän aariöpë thok në wɛ̈ɛ̈th/wëu.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Në dɛ̈t pe, abukuum Evangelos Kalousis acï mac wat cï yen yök ka de guöp awuɛc e jurthok në të den e luɔi.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts Flatly aci jääi bi luɛɛl ye kɔɔl no yɛɛn ye tiŋ e gɔl pïïr, thual rïïl wɛ̈n ye ŋɔr në thiɛɛc në raac e meth, luɛl de a lɛu ku abi thuŋde co rïïl yic arɛɛt.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Aci watden tuɛŋ ɣön ye luɛl Roe v. Wade e ye "lööŋ ke piny" në luɛl në lööŋ tɔ̈u në abukuum cin.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: Aci gäm aya nan rään anaŋ yic në thiään e kake yen ye Roe luɛl wɛ̈n.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydore aci ŋɔr ku wer Noosa, ke ye rään e rou në dhetɛɛm.
eng_text: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: Kek abi dhiäl yɔk në thiök e thɔɔk ku Noosa aciŋɔr kaa 11.
eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore aci Caboolture la wɔɔr.
eng_text: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae e baŋ e gɔl e Dromaeosauridae ku aruääi kenë Velociraptor.
eng_text: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: Kene acithiääŋ kene nɔ̈k, riɛmden e tuic ku diɛt cïï kon ya caath në cɔk ke rou ku anɔŋ riɛb bɛɛr cïï Velociraptor.
eng_text: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Riɛbden e rou e dït, yën cɔl yen Hasperonychus, wɛ̈n yen ye "rieb ke baŋ cääm'
eng_text: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Cït thuɔɔr ë ice, rɛɛc në ka cïï wo gɔɔr aci lon në kuany co rïïlic.
eng_text: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Acïï Pittman thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kɔ̈u lɔn cï lëu bïï ɣälaa röt agut cë yithbuɔ däŋic.
eng_text: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: Dït ku dhïl de duötë ice, në të cït tën ye Pittman ye yɔ̈k thïn, ee ye rɛ̈ɛ̈c tene kɔc cath wïïr thɛɛr në run kee 15 cë bak
eng_text: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Ke wɛrde thou cennë raanë nok acï piŋ ɣän ëbɛ̈n tïnoŋ jur rɛɛr Red Lake yic nïye kɔlë ku löŋde raan cɔl Jeff Weise ku jɔlya koi kɔ̈k cïkke nok ke dhoŋuan acë loi ayadde ku naan maan cï mɛnh dɛŋ de thukul acï dhɔɔm nï këdde kɔc cïkke moc kë pɛi nïn 21 pɛi  dhïc.
eng_text: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Ku kɔc akuma aciën këdït cïk luɛɛl bic nïye këde döm/mɛ̈c ye kɔɔlë.
eng_text: Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest.

text: Ku yen eci lɛɛk akutnhom de kɔc  cɔl Minneaopolis Star-Tribune kɔcke  ŋic ye tën yiɛp e cok thin lɔn ye yen mɛnh la ruön 16 cɔl Louis Jourdain, wɛ̈n raan cɔl Floyd Jourdain bëny muuk Red Lake Tribunal.
eng_text: However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain.

text: Acï ŋiic naan bï kuum yïdë ku naan yeŋo bï kɔc luuŋ luɛl tïnoŋ mɛnh kor kan ku ye kanɣic lukde mɛhn kor acï rɔt gɔl tëdde bulluk nhïïm.
eng_text: It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.

text: Acï Lodin luɛl aya kɔc ke luoi la tuɛŋ temkɔ̈u agɔke Afghans kony agɔke wenhden cïï rääc ku cïkï tiit e cuɔt dɛ̈t cï tɔ̈u.
eng_text: Lodin also said officials decided to cancel the runoff in order to save Afghans the expense and security risk of another election.

text: Kɔc cï pïoc aaye jam ku luɛlke acï juɛr tën loŋ ke Afghans wɛ̈n ye cuɔt co cï rot loi.
eng_text: Diplomats said that they had found enough ambiguity in the Afghan constitution to determine the runoff as unnecessary.

text: Në alïäm cïï nyoth wɛ̈n, temkɔ̈u e cuat acë tɔ̈u e löŋ.
eng_text: This contradicts earlier reports, which said that cancelling the runoff would have been against the constitution.

text: Thaira e la baŋ e Irkutsk ku e ci cääth në kɔc ke baŋ thïn.
eng_text: The aircraft had been headed to Irkutsk and was being operated by interior troops.

text: Thiëc ee cïï co tɔ̈u ago ke ci rot cääric.
eng_text: An inquiry was established to investigate.

text: Kënë II-76 e rïïl e kɔc ke Russia ku jɛɛc ke Soviet jäl e ruun e 1970 yic ku aci dɛɛŋ e thrumbil la gɔk ye pɛɛn ɣɔn ci la.
eng_text: The Il-76 has been a major component of both the Russian and Soviet military since the 1970s, and had already seen a serious accident in Russia last month.

text: Kë pɛi e Thiäär ee nïn 7, kë makana e cïï tem roor në jäälyic ka cin ke cë riääk. Russia acë II-76 tɔ̈ɔ̈u piny në riääkyic.
eng_text: On October 7 an engine separated on takeoff, without injuries. Russia briefly grounded Il-76s after that accident.

text: Miles ke 800 ke Trans-Alaska Pipeline System acithiɔk wat e jääth cë wɛɛl rool në baŋ piiny ë Fairbanks Alaska.
eng_text: 800 miles of the Trans-Alaska Pipeline System were closed down following a spill of thousands of barrels of crude oil south of Fairbanks, Alaska.

text: Ciën riɛl acïï thɛɛm de mac co loi wɛ̈n yen jääth co wal wei në baŋ ë Fort Greely.
eng_text: A power failure following a routine fire-command system test caused relief valves to open and crude oil overflowed near the Fort Greely pump station 9.

text: Në baŋ ɣɔ̈r acïï cänh ë jääth co kor ku cääth në të cet barmiil ke 55,000 (të cït gallon kaa mallion kaa 2.3).
eng_text: The valves opening allowed a pressure release for the system and oil flowed on a pad to a tank that can hold 55,000 barrels (2.3 million gallons).

text: Në köl e ŋuan aköl lɛɛric, ɣɔn tank ke jääth ke ŋɔt ke kuɛɛr, ke wɛ̈n e loi rot wat a tuɛɛc wɛ̈n cïï rɔt loi në tankyic.
eng_text: As of Wednesday afternoon, the tank vents were still leaking probably from thermal expansion inside the tank.

text: Anaŋ biääk piny e tank wɛ̈n ye lɛu bi barrel ke 104,500 jɔt akënë (akëcë) thiööŋ.
eng_text: Another secondary containment area below the tanks capable of holding 104,500 barrels was not yet filled to capacity.

text: Në ye jɛɛmyic në dhölë television , aye nyuɔth nän kɔc dït ke Iran acë gam wɛ̈t e wɛɛc e kaŋ yën cïï kä juëc rac.
eng_text: The comments, live on television, were the first time that senior Iranian sources have admitted that the sanctions are having any effect.

text: Acïï thɔl ke cääth e wëu ku thuɔk e jɔt e miök be kɔc ke European Union wɛ̈n yen ye thuŋ de Iran co yök 80 ë bɔɔtic në wënh bɔ̈ bic.
eng_text: They include financial restrictions and a ban by the European Union on the export of crude oil, from which the Iranian economy receives 80% of its foreign income.

text: Tën kuɛ̈nden de pɛi, OPEC acë jääm ku luelke jɔɔt de miök aci nyiin la piny apɛi në run thiärou cïï la në të cït mallion kaa 2.8 në kööl tökic.
eng_text: In its most recent monthly report, OPEC said exports of crude had fallen to their lowest level for two decades at 2.8 million barrels per day.

text: Bëny dït e bääi, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, aci ŋääthe miök col "dhuɔm"  wen yen ci tɔ̈u jääl e kɔɔl e thɔɔr e Iran Islamic ne ruun e 1979 ku ye ke wɛ̈n bi këk rɔt nyaai thïn.
eng_text: The country's supreme leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, has described the dependency on oil as "a trap" dating from before Iran's Islamic revolution in 1979 and from which the country should free itself.

text: Të cïï capsule la Earth ku lɛɛr e luadyic tën thää 5 nhiääkduur (thää aalɔŋ cuëëc), aye ŋic ka ruɛɛl baŋ e tueŋ e California Oregon Nevada ku Utah.
eng_text: When the capsule gets to Earth and enters the atmosphere, at about 5am (eastern time), it is expected to put on quite a light show for folks in Northern California, Oregon, Nevada, and Utah.

text: Capsule abithɔŋ kene kuɛl ci muɔc luätic.
eng_text: The capsule will look much like a shooting star going across the sky.

text: Capsule abë cääth tën 12.8 km walɛ 8 miles në dekik tɔk, piääl lëu ku yën co jɛl San Francisco lɛɛr Los Angeles në dekik tɔkic.
eng_text: The capsule will be traveling at about 12.8 km or 8 miles per second, fast enough to go from San Francisco to Los Angeles in one minute.

text: Stardust abi ŋɔɔr ka ye toŋ e ka piol wɛ̈n këk tɔ̈u e luadic ye dhuk e pinynhom, aci ŋɔɔr ku wɛɛr piol ɣɔn e pɛɛn e dhiɛc ruun e 1969 në dhuŋ e Apollo X
eng_text: Stardust will set a new all-time record for being the fastest spacecraft to return to Earth, breaking the previous record set in May of 1969 during the return of the Apollo X command module.

text: Abi jääl lɛɛr baŋ e cääm e wɛɛr e baŋ tueŋ e California ku abi  ɣɛɛr bääi pääne California lɛɛr baŋ cɛɛl e Oregon ku tɛɛk Nevada ku Idaho ku lɛɛr Utah, luel abiŋɔɔr e Stardust Project Tom Duxbury.
eng_text: “It will move over the west coast of northern California and will light the sky from California through central Oregon and on through Nevada and Idaho and into Utah,” Tom Duxbury, Stardust's project manager said.

text: Tä ë Mr. Rudd ku bë wɛɛrɛŋ e Kyoto në gɛɛr në kaŋ cï wo gɔɔr acë paanë United States tɛ̈k bei ke ye paan cën dïren.
eng_text: Mr. Rudd's decision to sign the Kyoto climate accord isolates the United States, which will now be the only developed nation not to ratify the agreement.

text: Akuma thɛɛr de Australia acë jäi në ye wɛɛrɛŋ e Kyoto, aye luel alëu ku bë cɛɛŋ rac në ye ŋaathden në hääj e cool, ku bɛɛi cit India ku China akin yɔɔk në ye alïïr rac në kaamdenic.
eng_text: Australia's former conservative government refused to ratify Kyoto, saying it would damage the economy with its heavy reliance on coal exports, while countries like India and China were not bound by emissions targets.

text: Yen ke ye aguɛɛr dït ë tɔɔr në baŋ ke akökööl ke eBay
eng_text: It is the biggest acquisition in eBay's history.

text: Kɔmpänï eye nhiaar ku bë lui baŋ dït apɛi wɛ̈n yen ye Skype lui thïn arsst ku jääk në baŋ dït ago thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kekë paanë China, Eastern Europe ku Brazil.
eng_text: The company hopes to diversify its profit sources and gain popularity in areas where Skype holds a strong position, such as China, Eastern Europe, and Brazil.

text: Scientist aacë Enceladus yök kë ye töŋ de loi ku yen ke Saturn gäm gɔɔlke.
eng_text: Scientists have suspected Enceladus as geologically active and a possible source of Saturn's icy E ring.

text: Enceladus ke baŋ töŋ e kääk tɔ̈u në luäät yic ye ruɛɛl aköl nyaai, kën ee ya të cït 90 në bɔɔtic.
eng_text: Enceladus is the most reflective object in the solar system, reflecting about 90 percent of the sunlight that hits it.

text: Kɔc ke cääl e thuɛc në ye köölë acë jam ku luel ke thuɛc Fallujah abë liu në nïn kaa dhetem iic në thöl ë werɛɛk ke Konami ë Japan.
eng_text: The game publisher Konami stated today in a Japanese newspaper that they will not be releasing the game Six Days in Fallujah.

text: Thuëëc kën atɔ̈u wɛ̈t e thɔ̈r ë rou e Fallujah, tɔŋ ril wɛ̈n ë tɔ̈u në kaam ë jɛɛc American ku Iraqi.
eng_text: The game is based on the Second Battle of Fallujah, a vicious battle between American and Iraqi forces.

text: ACMA aya aci yök  ago bïdïyo ya nyoth në baŋ ë intɛ̈rnɛt, kɔc ke Big Brother akën loŋ ke intɛ̈rnɛt guir yen kën ye bïdïyoo nyoth në wɛ̈pthait në Big Brother yic.
eng_text: The ACMA also found that despite the video being streamed on the Internet, Big Brother had not breached online content censorship laws as the media had not been stored on Big Brother's website.

text: Kɔc ke lon e cääl aci loŋ ke nyoth e käŋ na baŋ ë intɛ̈rnɛt, ago kɛ dun nyoth gam ka yiin ci ku ba naŋ serverdu.
eng_text: The Broadcasting Services Act provides for the regulation of Internet content, however to be considered Internet content, it must physically reside on a server.

text: Akuma ë United State wɛ̈n yen tɔ̈u Nairobi Kenya acë kɔc lɛ̈k wɛ̈t "kɔc gät kek tɔ̈u Somalia"  aguir rot ku bïkï Kenya ku Ethupia biökyic në bomb.
eng_text: The United States embassy located in Nairobi, Kenya has issued a warning that "extremists from Somalia" are planning to launch suicide bomb attacks in Kenya and Ethiopia.

text: Aye paanë U.S.  Luel ka cë thok yök tɔŋ të kën rot nyuɔɔth wɛ̈n cë luɔi de nääkë rot ë ŋɛk ye tök në bomb lueel kubë "ɣändït ŋic keek" cuöny paanë Ethiopia ku Kenya.
eng_text: The U.S. says it has received information from an undisclosed source that specifically mentions the use of suicide bombers to will blow up "prominent landmarks" in Ethiopia and Kenya.

text: Kam këc amät gua jɔk ku Gɛ̈gɛ̈t colbert, Heck ku Johnson aci gɛ̈tgɛ̈t aköl tui jal thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ kek wel aköl da—kam thɛɛr ye kek mith pan— gɛ̈tgɛ̈t tenɛ UW ruon 1988.
eng_text: Long before The Daily Show and The Colbert Report, Heck and Johnson envisioned a publication that would parody the news—and news reporting—when they were students at UW in 1988.

text: Kam gɔl ye cök, bathal aci ya ke ye wël lueel, ke waraga ye lɔ̈k bei, ku tenɛ kuen ci 5,000,000 jɔɔl loi thöök e pen Thiäär yic, kaŋ e raan ye ɣaac wei e kaam 24 wel ci kuen ku kaam thiɔk war ci jal acik bëi kenɛ pinynhom ye cɔl Dumb world.
eng_text: Since its inception, The Onion has become a veritable news parody empire, with a print edition, a website that drew 5,000,000 unique visitors in the month of October, personal ads, a 24 hour news network, podcasts, and a recently launched world atlas called Our Dumb World.

text: Al Gore ku bɛny ye cɔl Tommy Franks  aci jal kuen wël baai keen nhiaarke (Gore ka bathal aci jal ban lueel ala Tipper aci yok ka ci tɔc ka guäc rot kam dit töt run 2000 kuenykueny ci yen wiik thiin).
eng_text: Al Gore and General Tommy Franks casually rattle off their favorite headlines (Gore's was when The Onion reported he and Tipper were having the best sex of their lives after his 2000 Electoral College defeat).

text: Kɔcken juëc e gɛ̈tgɛ̈t aci la rac nhom tenɛ wël a mat Jon Stewart ku Stephen.
eng_text: Many of their writers have gone on to wield great influence on Jon Stewart and Stephen Colbert's news parody shows.

text: Ka ci jal  looi ka tëët dit töt e kene ye jaŋ jaam nhom tenɛ pan Bucharest pandiit gɛu ke wic be thura pandiit Romanian jal ban nyuööth ka dheeŋ pan metoroplic.
eng_text: The artistic event is also part of a campaign by the Bucharest City Hall that seeks to relaunch the image of the Romanian capital as a creative and colourful metropolis.

text: Pandiit kenɛ ayen be käŋ ben alɔŋ e pan Europe  tenɛ alɔŋ cam ku ciën be weŋ jal nyuɔɔth jäŋ yic, ke ye dït pinynhom ci jal tiŋ e pen e Dhetom ku pen e Bɛ̈t ye ruön kenɛ yic.
eng_text: The city will be the first in southeastern Europe to host CowParade, the world's largest public art event, between June and August this year.

text: Wël akol ci akuma ban lueel aye nyuɔɔth ke ci lueel kam pen Diak ruön kenɛ yic ke ci kek ye gam bik ka kɔk bi jɔt tɔ̈u piny wëu.
eng_text: Today's announcement also extended the government's commitment made in March of this year to fund extra carriages.

text: Ka kɔ̈k mat thiin 300 aca kuen yath 1,300 kaŋ jötjöt ku ba kuɔ̈ɔ̈t nhom tet yic.
eng_text: An additional 300 brings the total to 1,300 carriages to be acquired to relieve overcrowding.

text: Raan cɔl Christopher Garcia, aye wël apuruuk e pan Los Angeles lueel wei, aci jal lueel ela muony leŋ guöp awuöc aci jal gɔ̈t thok ke ci yen tëëk pan raan da ku ace ke ci yen kä ke raan da rac.
eng_text: Christopher Garcia, a spokesperson of the Los Angeles Police Department, said the suspected male offender is being investigated for trespassing rather than vandalism.

text: Ke ci gɔ̈t akëc riääk; ke ci war yic aci looi ka rɔɔth kin macär ke ci jal gɔ̈t thiin e wel dɔ̈ɔ̈r ku puɔ̈u ku "O" war yic be jal kuen ka ye urub piiny "e".
eng_text: The sign was not physically damaged; the modification was done using black tarpaulins decorated with signs of peace and heart to alter the "O" to read lowercase "e".

text: Alɔŋ malual kene ye bei ee ke diit cɔl Karenia brevis, ye tök ci cak e pic yic.
eng_text: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism.

eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Raan thiaar ku bɛ̈t buɔt nhom pan cɔl Venezuela acin nhiim luɔi ku kɔc kok lui aci lui loiloidit bi kek jääk.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Pan Venezuela alaŋic jath ye ɣäc bɛ̈i kokic ku äa kɔc lïk kek lui thin.

eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Të wïc raan yen bï piöc kä ye kɔc jam aliir yic, ka wïc bï raan kaŋ piɔ̈ɔ̈c të ye luɔ̈i keek ku bï luɔ̈ŋ ye nuɛ̈ɛ̈t bï kɔc jal jam kaŋ ŋic cï mën (Thuura dhie kë wïc ba lueel nyuɔɔth, rör jam, ku të ye bïdïyo cɔ̈k piny thïn, ku luɛl anyïköl).
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: ku të ye ke nuɛ̈ɛ̈t thïn, ku të ye të ca täk yen kaŋ bɛn laath yic apath, të wïc yïn yen ba wël yäth aliir yic, ku ba rot piɔ̈ɔ̈c ërin ba ya tak të bïï käŋ röt waar thïn të looi yïn keek.

text: Kë rac tënë thoŋ kamara dhie käŋ cuɔ̈t të thiɔ̈k ku ben ku cuɔt të meec, ee kë yen wïc lon rir yic ku ba thok juääc keen kä ya cɔ̈k piny ku kë mec jal tïŋ, ace thöŋ kek thoŋ kamara cïn yic kën käŋ cuɔt wei ku ben ke cuɔ̈t të thiɔ̈k.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Amat nhom bɛ̈i Yurup εe wicke bik riel thɔ̈ŋ nyin bi cien pan nhomlau pandet la racic.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Amat nhom bɛ̈i Yurup εe wicke bi cen pan riil apei εe yen athɔ̈ŋ kek riel nyin kujɔlke pamathken äa geer.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Tɔŋ Pan Spain tueŋ ee thar wet bi riel thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ nyin.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: War ci tɔŋtɔŋ yiëth ban puol go kajuec rot waar na cɔk alon ci kek ruon thiar diak kaŋ nok kethaar.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Yanh cɔl Sikhism εe gɔ̈l rot pan cɔl Punjabi ruon 1500 kujɔl wɛ̈r piny
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Liɛr piny ayen ke rac ye raan kec rot guir rɔm ke yen.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Tɛ nem yin Pinymaŋök kam liir piny (e rin tɛ leer yin alɔŋ ciɛm, ka bï liɛr apɛi), a riir apɛi ba alɛth tuctuc bɛi.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Nïn bar mɛi yic a nin pɛn kɔc ku loi kɔc be ka tuäny.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Möï, cath piny eya dhiër Nordic ku ace tuaany bɛ̈i, akɔc geet.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Të cɔŋ käŋ ɣɔc San Francisco dït pinynhom bik kɔc ya bɛ̈i, ka kën ɣɔc atɛ̈kic.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Ke dït kɔc luoi apɛi akaŋ kɔc cï piöc, akuma, käŋ weu, käŋ ɣɔc, ku käŋ kɔc piny cääth.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Aye lac nyuɔɔth tenɛ wäk, tenɛ däi, piöc ku ciɛŋ ŋic acï kony bik gɛu cɔl a ŋic pinynhom.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco acï dït bi ya pan dïït ye kɔc piny cääth thiin kek ɣööt juac niin, tenɛ cɛm, ku tenɛ ɣän amɛtmɛt.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco aya e pan pɛth leŋ yic Cäm/mïth kɔc Asia: Korea, Thai, Indian, ku Japanese.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Cäth bi la Walt Disney pinynhom aye jal nyuɔɔth ke dït nem tenɛ Nhialic e kɔc pan America.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: "Kuät" nem tɔ̈u aye kɔc pɛ̈ɛ̈r Orlando International Airport yic, ku jɔl lɔ Disney hotel yic, acï rëër käŋ Disney yic, ku dhuk bääi.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Aleŋ kajuääc loi thook, kua kenɛ aŋuät ye ke kɔc luel al "lɔ pinynhom Disney".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Wɛrɛk käc juäc aci ɣäc wei tenɛ gɛtgɛt teme eBay kua Craigslist aye ka juec warɛɛk ye loi.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Cɔŋ alɔn yeken yelac loi, acï Disney peen: warɛɛk ace köök.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kuät amɛt bi loi Canyon yic awic wɛrɛk e rin bi jal guotpiny.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Wɛrɛk ake ye Canyon gel yetok, ku abi jal tɔ̈u thin aköl tueŋ e pɛɛi yic, pɛɛi ka ŋuan lɔn ŋuät këc pen dɛ̈t jɔk.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Ka yen, wɛerek e baai ajök niin pen Dhiëc abi jaal tɔu akol niin tök pen Tök.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Ta laau yic ɣɔn ŋic, cemen Angel ɣer tenɛ Camp rek yenhom kek Phantom Ranch, aci thiɔ̈ŋ ka ci thiëc bï ka dom akol tueŋ ci domdom ŋäny.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Yen tɛn piny alëëk tïnoŋ koi cï thɛɛc bï nyin dɛn waan ku yen ɛɛ ya na cï raan dhooc gat yennë yekke lui.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Lur thin apirka ciɛm yic thurumbil e ke pɛth ye dheŋ bai tiŋ kue ke ye dhel ye piny caath ban yök.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Kënë aye loi thurumbil yic path ka loi amath ku 4x4 ayen path ku te riec eben aye yök kek cök thurumbil dit tot 4x4.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Jɔl ŋic yi nhom la ta cɔŋ Southern Africa tɔu ciɛm yic laŋ dɔ̈ɔ̈r ka ce bɛi thiäk kek yen eben.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Wereek ye wic ku wëu ye tɔ̈u piny aloi thok tene bai ku bai kua ye ka tiäm pan bii yin thin.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Kuät bai eben aleŋ yic lɔŋ ken loi thok kene ye wic kaŋ bi reer thurumbil yic.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls e gɛu tɔ̈u alɔŋ tueŋ Zimbabwe yic, akeu thok tenɛ Livingstone, Zambia, ku Botswana lɔ̈m.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Gɛu athiɔ̈k kek falls, ku ke a ka dït ye kɔc cath, kua te dït ye cath ŋic ken aye bɛ̈i ka juëc kɔc piny nhom cath ku tiŋ ku jal ka path kɔ̈k e rin bïk jal rëër thin kam bär kɔ̈u.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Kam tuɛny deŋ (pen thiar ku tok bi la pen diak), piu abi la nhial apɛi ku Falls abi jal loi käŋ jäŋ gɔ̈i.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Yin abi guop tiäp te tem yin kubur kɔ̈u kua ba cath te thiäk kek Falls.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ka te dɛt, e wɛt ci piu la nhial apɛi yen cï yin Falls ye tiŋ apath rin ci piu ye kum nyin!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Tiɔm Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 ayen tiɔm ŋic apɛi Valley yic, tene Howard Carter ruön 1922 aci ya tene ci nyuɔth ci bɛ̈ny thin yam thiɔ̈k thin.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Te thöŋ yen kek tiop bäny kɔ̈k, ka yen, tiɔm Tutankhamun ace nem, rin koor yen ku kec e dheŋ.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Kuät raan wic be tiŋ kene ye nyuɔth ka ci riak mama guop abi man e kam bi ye bei kën yen guɔ̈p täu thïn yic abi puou riäk e rin e yen nhom ku ket a kek ye tiŋ.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kä path jiɛk tɔ̈u tiɔp yic a këc ban rëërr thin, kua ci bɛi bei tenɛ Egyptian Museum tenɛ Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Jɔl leŋ kam kor abi piath bïk rëër të dɛ̈t.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, mitir 12 alɔŋ ciɛm ku tueŋ tɔ̈u Siem Reap. Luäŋ kurnhom aci buth thok ruön bɔɔt kaa 9th, kam ë bɛ̈ny Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Dheŋ luäŋ nhialic ku dai Tonle Sap lake nhom loi tönytöny kur ke path.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Nem tenɛ luɔi aleu mat kek cath riai akuäk yic.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass aye wic bin la luäŋ nhialic ka yen duk nhom mar ba passport du bɛi kek yin ta leer yin Tonle Sap yic.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusalem ee gɛu ku e gen dïït Israel, ka bɛ̈i kɔk ku Uwan ace ye ŋic ke ye gen Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Gen dïït thɛɛr kur Judea aleŋ käŋ pɛth tim ruön juäc.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Gɛu adheŋ tene bɛ̈i wɛt nhialic ka diak teme Judaism, Krithian ku Islam, ku e lui ka ye kene wei, kenë wɛt nhialic ku kene ciɛŋ.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Rin riɛr wɛt nhialic gɛu yic, ku yen aya tɛ juäc gen thɛɛr, Jerusalem e tɛ dït ye kɔc piny nem bɛ̈n thin Israel yic.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusalem aleŋ ka juëc kɛŋ, käŋ kɔc luɔ̈i thɛɛr, tenë ciɛŋ, kek tenë ɣɔ̈c cï thiäŋ, cafés, ku ɣän cäm/mïth.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador aye wic be kɔc Cuba bïk dɔm athöör cï ka cɔl e rin bïk jal bɛn pan Ecuador alɔŋ airports kɛm bɛi kua tenɛ nhom nhial ye kɔc lor thin.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Athöör kenɛ awic bi Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs dhiɛl gäm, ku jɔl ke mat kɔk ye wïc.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Ka ye wïc ka aye loi bïk kök ya cɔl apuɔlic kɛm bɛi ka dhië.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Kɔc Cuba muk athöör maŋök Amerika aleu bïk Ecuadorian Consulate la nem ku be ka jal puöl ke ye wïc kene yic.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Wereŋ cäth (Passport) du aleu bi ya ke lui pɛi ka detom niin kun käc. Athör lɔ ku dhuk aye wïc bi yi jal puöl ka kenɛ nyuɔɔth bin reer käm bar kɔu.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Nɛm piny apuɔlic tenɛ kɔc juäc, tɛ yen yïn e rot kua math dun tok, ka them ba rɔm ka kɔc kɔk e rin ba laŋ akut kɔc ka ŋuan ku kɔc ka detom ba ke pɛth raan kek raan.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Ka yen, kenɛ aceleu bi diir, e rin tɛ dɛt kɔc nem piny aye liäp bïk thurumbil thiɔŋ.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Aye tiŋ ka ye dhel ye kɔc duöŋ bïk tɔu piny ka juäc.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ɣööt nhial alɔŋ cuëëc tenɛ Machu Picchu aleŋ ic kur lɔr piny, abak aya kene ka juɛc ci thur rac.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Aye tiŋ ka riir ic piny, ku amec ku a riir ic be leu, kua raan riir tɔr aleu be tɔny kam 45 yic.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Alëël ye kac aci tɔu dhel ic ku abil ye kɔc lɔr piny akɔc kony kɔc cin.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ka ke ci lueel kenɛ, jɔl ŋic yï cï bi wei, ku jɔl rot ŋiɛc loi tɛ lɔr piny, temenë tɛ cï yen tiɔptiɔp, e rin aleu bi lac bɛn e ke rac.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Aleŋ cave thin nyɔt tɔu nhial bi kɔc dhiɛl reet thin, atɔu nhom piny ku aci nyiɛc ic.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Të cïn tëdäŋ tiŋ ku läi ɣɔ̈ŋken Galapagos aye loi apath e riäi, të menë ci Charles Darwin aye loi ruön 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Ka juääc 60 cruise riɛth acath pïu Galapagos - ka juec yic alɔŋ thin ke jɔt e raan 8 ku 100.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Kɔc juec aci te den dɔm tueŋ (e rin riɛth athiäŋ kam tɔ̈u nhial).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Ba jal ŋic raan ye yin dɔm e raan ŋic Galapagos apath kek pɛth riɛth.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Kene abi ye loi be dun wïc ku/kua kaŋ yi gel aci thöŋ kek riɛt rɔm ka kek.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Men këc Spanish gua bɛn ruön bɔɔt ka 16 yic, alɔŋ cuëc Chile ye ka tɔ̈u mɛemɛc Inca ku kɔc Araucanians (Mapuche) aci jal reer ciɛl ku ciɛm Chile.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche ee pan töŋ yök nhomlääu ciën pan akutnhïïm kɔc thɛɛr America, këc kek mat ciɛŋ kɔc jam thoŋ Spanish agut thaar bïn Chile nhomlääu yök.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Tɛ cɔŋ Chile cɔl ka ye bai e rot ruon1810 (tɔŋ Napoleon yic ke ci Spain nyäŋ piny ka cïn akuma lui tenɛ run juäc), tiam cïk Spanish tiäm akec rot leu leer ruon 1818 yic.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) ye pan Caribbean tɔ̈u alɔŋ ciën tɛ thöny Hispaniola, ke ye rɔm kek Haiti
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Menë liɛt mabiör ku kur piny, bäi e pan gen dït European thɛɛr America yic, emenë alɔŋ Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Tɛ thöny ka ci kaŋ nyuöcic kɔc Taínos ku Caribes. Caribes aka ye kɔc jam Arawakan ka bɔ e ruön 10,000 BCE yic.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Run thik lik yic wen ci Kɔc keny piny lei European bɛ̈n, thän Tainos acï kɔc nɔŋ riɛl Spanish tek ic.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Fray Bartolomé de las Casas nhom (Tratado de las Indias) kam 1492 ku 1498 kɔc nɔŋ riɛl Spanish acï raan 100,000 tenɛ Taínos nɔ̈k.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Tɛ lau kene acï buth ka ye atrium tenɛ amat 17th-century, ka ye yen ɣɔn töŋ Templo de San Diego cï döŋ ka käc.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Menë alui ka ye plaza tɔu ciɛl, ku e laŋ ka loi rot kam yic eben, akol ku thei.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Aleŋ ɣän yen kɔc cam/mïth thïn juäc cï dom kam ciɛl, ku täŋ akɔl ku thei thok ku concerts epath aye gäm gazebo ciɛl.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley cim thok). Balconies acï 69 cï them centimeters tek ic e pan raan dït thɛɛr nhiɛr.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Kek wei thik lik mïth kɔk abï lɛk käŋ.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Bowen thöny e ŋic ye kɔc lɔ thïn akol kua nïn ka dhorou nɛm piny jɔl kɔc yek käc kayaking, dukan, ɣän cäm, ku kɔk.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Akut kɔc kenɛ atɔ̈u Röl Howe yic alɔŋ Vancouver, ku aye yök tenɛ piu thurumbil ka jal Granville thöny gen Vancouver yic.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Tenɛ kɔc nhiär thueec aɣeer, cath ba lɔ war ic leer Ɣän ye tëëk tɔ̈u Nhial apath.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (kam 1.5 cuɛ̈th tenɛ Vancouver) aya wëu tɔ̈u nhial ku ŋic apɛi wɛ̈t 2010 rut Olympics.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Rut yic, jɔl thuëëc tenɛ America cuëëc, ku tuɔ̈c piny jɔl them ba cuäth ajala kur nhom.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Permits abi lel thok tueŋ.Yïn lë ba laŋ permit ba jal rëër thëi Sirena yic.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena yen tɛ̈ töŋ ranger station leŋ yic dormitory lodging ku ciɛm tuc ku camping aya. La Leona, San Pedrillo, ku Los Patos aleŋ camping e rot ku ciɛm aliu.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Alë ba yök park permits tenɛ Ranger Station Puerto Jiménez yic, kua ace credit cards gam.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: ka ye loi Park yic (MINAE) ace gɛm park permits pɛi juëc wan tök thok ka bɛn ŋuɔt ŋoot.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol agɛm luɔi ye kaŋ dɔm kek wëu US$30, kua $10 kene cath nien tök; kajuëc atɔ̈u Corcovado page yic.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Cook thöny e pan thöny ka tɔ̈u kek New Zealand, ka tɔ̈u Polynesia, cɛl alɔŋ war South Pacific.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Kene archipelago kek tɛ̈ thöny ka thiar ku dhiec 15 cï wɛ̈r piny mitir 2.2 million war yic.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Kek kam thöŋ cemën Hawaii, tɛ̈ thöny të dɛ̈t aye luel "Hawaii piny cök".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Tɛ̈ cɔŋ kor yen, a kɔc dït jɔl täk nhiim wɛ̈t Hawaii wan kec guä ya bai acin yic ɣöt dït kɔc dai ku kɔ̈k ci guir.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Cook thöny acin yic gɛth, kua leŋ yic tɛ̈ thöny thiar ku dhiëc 15. Käŋ ŋic kek a Rarotonga ku Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Bɛ̈i cï guir yic yaköl, aleŋ agereem deluxe ku cɛ̈m nhiäknhiäk acï yäth nhial ke pɛth art dhëŋ-
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Nhom thök yic, B&Bs awɛ̈r kaŋ ka rou yic: agereem ku cɛm nhiäknhiäk.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Ke ya, ten ka pɔth ka cït ka ka aye loi ku yök agerem dhëŋ, ce mɛnë ke cï cuëëc kɔc ciin kua agerem cï ŋiɛc guir.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Cɛ̈m nhiäknhiäk aya ka cït ka pɔth cɛ̈mcɛ̈m bai kua kaŋ cɛ̈m nhier jäl.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Juër aken ɣöt buth thɛɛr kek juër loi thok, piny cï wec yic ku kɔt e kuaŋ.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Leer yïn thurumbil du yic ku lɔɔr e dhël mec yic aleŋic ke pɛth puɔlic kua dhëŋ.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Na ce thurumbildït, yïn cï piöc cuɛth thurumbildu ku yïn kën ye göök.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Gut piny keemɔ tënɛ̈ bai ku aɣeer jäŋic ka kor ku abï dït a kɔc cï wïc gool.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Kä cekic, kuɛ̈th thurumbildu e dhël pɔth bïn cäth dhëlic ku a yen ë rot e tënɛ̈ "camp".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Camping thurumbil a puɔlic tɛ̈ leŋ yïn këdït minivan, SUV, Sedan ku Station Wagon kek thöc cï thiɛt piny.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Ɣän nïn/tëc jiirke/jurke abak aleŋ dik thɛɛr kathäär ku wër cï kuer nhiim; ŋuɔt këc tɔŋ pinynhom rou bɛn, kam ruön bɔɔt ka 19th kua tueŋ kam ruön bɔɔt ka 20th.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Ɣän nïn/tëc jiirke/jurke a käŋ ye kɔc jɛɛk ku ŋic apɔth, ku alaŋ tɛ̈ pɛth cɛm ku pïïr thei.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Cëŋcëŋ thɛɛr, nöŋ kä dhëŋ yam, ku dhiöp pɛth tɔ̈u thïn a käŋ cɛŋden.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Cɔŋ alɔn ye kek kaŋ raan, tɛ̈ dɛ̈t a rëër ka jɔl bäny bɛ̈i ku kɔc ril kɔ̈k.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Raan cath ka wëu juëc alëu be täk be cath pinynhom, cï ɣäric rëër juëc Ɣän nïn/tëc jiirke/jurke ka yic.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Käc pɔ̈u cï matic akut kɔc cath ku kɔc bai nuɛt gɛth leer kek thïn.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Mɛt rot thïn amat cït kënɛ̈ yic ba athör thiɔ̈ŋ online; cɔŋ alɔn ye amat kɔ̈k gɛm kua awïc dɛ̈t bï cɔk yic.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Adan kɔc tɔ̈u kɔc loor abi jal nyuɔɔth ka cï print ku/kua online, tɛ̈ deŋ yen ke tuɔɔc thïn ku laŋ cɛɛth tënɛ̈ kɔc kɔ̈k cath.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Rëër pan randɛ̈t ajɔk cök Nyeth 2004 wär cï computer programmer Casey Fenton jal yök flight puɔlic leer Iceland kua cïn tɛ̈ rëër yen thïn.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Acï mïth a bun tɔ̈u pan abun tuɔ̈c imeel ku jɔl yök kɔc juëc wïc yen be bɛ̈n bïk ban rëër e pɔth.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Ɣän nïn/tëc jiirke/jurke alui tënɛ̈ kɔcthii yam– jɔl aya reer ruon thiɛr rou yic– kua kɔcdït cath cï dhiɔp aye yök thïn ë ya.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Bɛ̈i leŋ yic mïth ace lac tïŋ, kua Ɣän nïn/tëc jiirke/jurke abak akek puöl bïk la ɣööt kɔcic.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Gen Beijing tɔ̈u China ayen gen bï Winter Olympic Games thuëëc thïn ruön 2022, ke bë ye loi bï ya yen gen tueŋ ben summer ku winter Olympics loi kadhie.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing abe yän ŋäny thok ku thiɔ̈k thok loi ku jal thuëëc ice ye loi alɔŋthïn.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Thuëëc kɔ̈k skiing abe loi tënɛ̈ piny Taizicheng ski Zhangjiakou yic, tɛ̈ cït mitir 220 (140 miles) mɛnë Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Ɣän cäär juëc aleŋ yäi yen loi jɔk rot ɣɔrbɛkläi be lɔ thök Aduöŋ yic ciɛl, kua loi thok tënɛ̈ calendar kuat temple.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Yän cäär aye door ka ye kënɛ̈ temple den war jɔk ye cök kua akol wär dhiët bɛ̈ny kua yäi kɔk thiäk ka käŋ ɣän cäär.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Yäi ɣän cäär Kerala aka pɔth apɛi bë ka tïŋ, kek aköön cath ka cï dhëŋ, temple orchestra ku yɛth kɔ̈k.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Fair pinynhom (ye cɔl World Exposition, kua puɔlic Expo) a yän international dït tot kënɛ̈ arts ku sciences.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Bɛ̈ny cï mɛt thïn ajal nyoth artistic ku gɛ̈tgɛ̈t pavilions bai yic bïk kaŋ pinynhom jal nyuɔɔth kua cɛŋ panden ku käŋ.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Expositions a yäi ye guir be jal nyuɔɔth läi, dom dhëŋic ku kuät ka kɔ̈k ë tiim.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Ka yen ke ye kuen a rot loi ruönic ëbën (tɛ̈ rëër kek bɛ̈i loi thokic), tɛ̈ yen luɔi yic ka ce tɛ̈ de.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Ka ye door ka aye loi kam pɛi ka diäk ku pɛi ka detom, ku aye loi piny cï ce mɛnë 50 hectares.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Aleŋ film formats loi thok ye luöi run juäc yic. Ala cök 35 mm film (36 ku 24 mm negative) ayen ye lac yök.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Apuɔl yic be war tɛ̈ kɛt yïn aɣeer, ku gɛm tɛ̈ bi luɔ̈i yen arac ka thöŋ kek DSLR menëë.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Camera film format kɔ̈k tɔ̈u ciɛl aye lui format 6 ku 6 cm, kua cek yic ka ye 56 ku 56 mm negative.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Kënɛ̈ a tɛ̈ bi luɔ̈i yen bɛ̈i ka ye arak ŋuän kek ken e 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 ku 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Läiɣɔ̈ŋ aka motifs ril yic tënɛ̈ ran thur, ku awïc be ma ic kek duar guop, tiët, piöc ku käk luɔi pɔth.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Thur läi ɣɔ̈ŋ aye lac puɔ̈l e path, kua ke cït thur abɛ̈n, thura awar wël juëc.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Thur läi ɣɔ̈ŋ awïc telephoto lens bar, kua ka cït akut diɛt ku a ka thii kɔk cï cak awïc käk dai kɔ̈k.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Läi dït juëc a ril yic be ka yök, ku parks tɛ̈ dɛ̈t alaŋ löŋ kenɛ̈ thur käŋ ɣɔc wei.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Läiɣɔ̈ŋ aye riɔc kua aye baŋ. Piny aleu be liɛr, tuöc kua be rɛc.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Pinynhom aleŋic thok loi thook ka 5,000, e gut thiɛr rou 20 kek thier dhiëc 50 million kua kaŋ jam juëc.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Wël cï gɔ̈t apuɔl yic be ka dët mɛnë wël cï lueel, aya. Kenë ayic tënɛ̈ cɔ̈t bääi, ke ye riɛl be ka cɔl.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Bɛ̈i juëc a English cɔl a pɔth, ku ka juäc apɛi mɛnë ka ye täk ŋiec të mɛnë kɔcthi yam.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: jɔl tïŋ, tɛ̈ lëu yïn yen, Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican ku Sydneysider nyuc tharbeth lɔ̈m bïk mïth tënë restaurant Toronto yic.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ajam kam ken kaŋ gɛth bei kenë, lueel ka thuɔŋden ku cɔ̈tden.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: ɣɔ̈c cäm ɣän dït ɣɔɔc yic aya dhël puɔl yic ku ba cam.Tɛ̈ liu thät, kuënykuëny acek yic tënɛ̈ cäm cï thäl.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ɣän dït ɣɔɔc acï laŋ cäm cï thäl loi thok. Aleŋ cäm cï thal juëc loi thok. Kɔ̈k aleŋ microwave oven ku kɔ̈k ye cam tuööc.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Bɛ̈i kɔ̈k yic ku stores kɔ̈k aya laŋ ɣän cäm tök tɔ̈u, ka ye kenɛ̈ bai kek ɣɔc puɔlic.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Loi ku muk athör kaŋ löŋ e kɔc insurance kek contact details kek yïn.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Awïc bïk insurance e-mail address ku international phone numbers nyuɔɔth kene wët/ gɛmgɛm ku luɔi claims.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Ba laŋ copy dɛ̈t jɔga du yic ku aliiric (imeel tene yïn kek attachment, kua cï tɔ̈u "amar yic").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Tɛ̈ cɛth yïn kek laptop kua tablet, tɔ̈u abak kën tɔ̈ɔ̈u yic kua disc (e yök ka cïn internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Aya gam löŋ/kä cï thuur ke nambaai tënɛ̈ kɔc käc ku kɔc ken ruɛi kek kua mathken tɔ̈u bai wïc be ka kony.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Anhomgär (aya ye cɔl elk) ace baŋ, kua a rot kony tɛ̈ tïŋ kek ke rac.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Tɛ̈ këc kɔc anhomgär tïŋ ke ye ke rac, ka leu bïk lɔ tɛ̈ thiɔ̈k ku tɛ̈u ka röt ke rac thok.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Dek mɔ̈u amäth. Mɔ̈u akɔ̈c thöŋ gup tɛ̈ loi thok, ku ŋïcŋïc adan ye dek ake riil tör
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Käŋ röt loi pïïr yic dekdek mɔ̈u yic aka cït riɛ̈ŋ cuɛny, cöör ku thuɔ̈u. Kë rac kɔ̈c nɔ̈k arot juak tɛ̈ dek yïn mɔ̈n cï thiän.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Mäu cï aleŋic kärac kɔ̈c nɔ̈k cemenë methanol, kenë  cöör bɛ̈i ku thuɔ̈u tɛ̈ cɔŋ ye dek ka kor.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Käŋ nyin aye ɣɔ̈c wëu lik bɛ̈i kɔ̈k yiic, temenë bɛ̈i-lik wëu thïn tɛ̈ ye tenë luɔ̈i tɔ̈u piny wëu lik.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Jɔ̈l tak ba nyin them baai, temenë tɛ cï insurance ye loi, ku bɛ̈i ke cï ɣɔ̈c be thiɔ̈ŋ tɛ̈ dɛ̈t.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Tɛ̈ nhial-rin dït tɔ̈u ɣɔ̈n kä yic aleŋ kärac kaa rou; kɔ̈k aye yuöp- wei, ku kä ye bɛ̈i aɣeer aye ɣɔ̈c wëu juäc menë kä ɣɔ̈c baai.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Bun ake ye ɣäc wei piny nhom apɛi, ku kɔ̈k alëu ba ke yök pan dun yic.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Ka yen, aleŋ dhɛl juäc ye bun dek piny nhom wïc ba ke ŋic.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (ku: canyoneering) ake ye kɔ̈c la canyon cök, ka cï yic riɛl wala/ka athiɛŋ pïu.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning aye mat yic kek kuaŋ, tönytony ku käc--ku awïc piöc thin kor ku riɛl ba jɔ̈k cök (ba thoɔ̈ŋ kek tönytöny kur, käc scuba ku alpine skiing, cemenë).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Hiking ake ye loi aɣeer ke leŋic cath piny yic, aye rot lac loi jɛɛt e hiking.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Hiking aköl aleŋic kam cï kor mile be lɔ̈ tɛ̈ mec ye tëk aköl tök.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Hike aköl tenë tɛ puɔ̈l ic jɛɛt cï guir ye wïc, ku kuät raan kor alɔ̈ thïn.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Bɛ̈i leŋic mïth kor awïc juër rot dït, ku aköl aɣeer apuɔ̈lic ë gut kek mïth ku mïth këc gua lɔ̈ pan abun.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Bɛ̈i kɔ̈k yic, aleŋ kä cït 200 käŋ nɛm luɔ̈i. Kä juëc kek alui ë rot.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Tɛ̈ bɛm piny nhom cï rot war, lɔ̈ kenë kät nɛm ye tïŋ ka kät ye yök bɛ̈i kaa ŋuan yiic.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Kek cäk de tɛn kät nɛm Barcelona ku tɛn kät  Copenhagen, acï rot jal mat thïn tɛ̈n kät nɛm Prague tɔ̈u Prague ku kɔ̈k.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Aleŋ kä juëc wïc ba ke ŋic yï këc gua jäl ku tɛ̈ jël yïn ba la tɛ̈ dɛ̈t.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Tɛ̈ cɛth yïn, ŋic ba käŋ yök ka ce yen tɛ̈ den ye kek rot luɔ̈i thïn "pan dun". Ciɛŋ, löŋ, cɛm, dhɛ̈l, tɛ̈n nïn, piäth, thok ku kɔ̈k abe thok loi tenë kä tɔ̈u tɛ̈ ye yïn rëër thïn.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Kenë ake wïc ba ŋic, ku ba puöc cuk riäk ku mal kek tɛ̈ ye käŋ luɔ̈i thïn.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Tɛn kɔ̈c käc atɔ̈u menë 19th century. Raan kɔ̈c käc ayen ya ke path tɛ̈n käc e yam këc raan käc kaŋ yök piny nhom, ciɛŋ, thok ku bɛ̈i ye kɔ̈c dɔ̈m wëu lik thïn.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Tɛ̈ cɔŋ ye ɣɔ̈n juëc ye kɔ̈c käc thïn wïc kek yen bïk gät kä thɛɛr, kɔ̈c gɛ̈tgɛ̈t tenë käc aleŋ kë den loi thok käc, adan wëu ku tɛ̈ leer kɔ̈c thïn.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Apath bï ya raan käc gɛ̈tgɛ̈t lac gät ka cït kä kun käc bï ya yen le yïn gɛ̈t thïn.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Däi käŋ käc ye raan gɛ̈tɛ̈ɛt luel, tënë website ku aluit dukan yic.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Tɛ̈ wïc yïn yen ba piny nhom tïŋ ke puɔ̈lic, kenë ke riil, ciɛŋ wala/ka kë rac, aleŋ dhɛl juëc kɔ̈k ye ye loi.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Yen, alöny käŋ kaa rou yic: Alëu ba lui ka yï cath ku tek ɣäc du yic. Kë cï gɔ̈t kën ee kë ciën.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Tɛ̈ kɔ̈c wïc yen bïk miɛt puöu den puöl, kam ku tɛ̈ktɛ̈k bï ɣɔ̈c käŋ tekic adhuk piny, tïŋ tɛ̈ŋ wëu ë käc/cäth.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Kë ye luel aye gam la kɔ̈c cath acie cuëër, kuëc cath, lui ɣɔ̈c rac yic, lïm, ku ye acie rum kä ken bïk jak.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Tɛ̈ kök tuëc aye tɛ̈ tueŋ e kɔ̈ɔ̈c tɛ̈ kɛc yïn piny tiɛr yic, riäi ku thurumbil dɛ̈t yic.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Kathäär kɔ̈k- tem yic cɛth käŋ aye loi kathär kät yic ku yïn wïc ba laŋ ID lui kek yïn tɛ̈ kɛc yïn kathäär käkë yiic.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Kathäär yen kɔ̈c nin thïn makɔ̈u, awerek cäth (passports) aye kuöt ë ran nyin tït kathric ka yen niën du ace rac yic.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Gɛ̈t piny ake dɛ̈t ye wïc ba visa yök. Bɛi kɔ̈k, yïn rot gät piny ku tɛ̈ rëër yïn kek bäny baai.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Kënë awïc ba athör thiɔ̈ŋic kek apuruuk baai ku nem muktab kɔ̈c kök.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Bɛ̈i juäc yiic kek löŋ cït käkë, hotels baai abe gɛ̈tgɛ̈t piny loi (awïc bïn thiëc).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Kɔ̈kic, kɔ̈c tɔ̈u aɣeer tɛ̈ ce tɛ̈n kɔ̈c nem akek ye gät piny. Ka yen, kënë alöŋ loi be ka cuk ye detic, ka yen lɔ̈c ŋic tueŋ.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Ran thuur käŋ apɛi (Architecture) akën juër ku buthbuth ɣöt. Architecture tɛ̈ daŋ aya kënë kɔ̈c gool dhɛl de rot.
